# Beakdown

> Beakdown is a free single-player browser arcade game: fly a bird by flapping and destroy enemies by colliding with them from above, because the higher bird wins.

## Pages

- [Play Beakdown](https://beakdown.fun/): the game itself, no download or sign-up
- [About Beakdown](https://beakdown.fun/about-beakdown): the complete reference, with rules, controls, power-ups, arenas, scoring and a long FAQ
- [Flappy Bird unblocked](https://beakdown.fun/flappy-bird-unblocked): a playable page with an honest guide to the flap and one-button genre
- [Flappy Bird 2](https://beakdown.fun/flappy-bird-2): why no sequel exists and what wears the name
- [What happened to Flappy Bird](https://beakdown.fun/what-happened-to-flappy-bird): the sourced history, 2013 to today

Made by Nathan Haslewood (https://nathanhaslewood.com.au).
